theorem lg_target {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (fun x => Φ ↑x) s := by
  let f := fun x => Φ ↑x
  let x := s.re - 1 / 2
  have hx : x < s.re := by norm_num
  let g := fun n => Φ (n % N)
  have h_periodic : ∀ n, f n = g n := by intro n; rfl
  have h_bigO : g =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => ↑n ^ (x - 1) :=
    by
      let m := Nat.posOfNeZero N
      let c := max (Finset.univ.map (λ k : ZMod N, Complex.abs (Φ k))).sup
      have h_bound : ∀ n, |g n| ≤ c * ↑n ^ (x - 1) :=
        by intro n; calc |Φ (n % m)| ≤ c by simp
          ... ≤ c * ↑n ^ (x - 1) by simp
      apply BigO.bigO_le_const c
      apply BigO.eventually_le Filter.atTop
      intro n
      exact h_bound n
  have h_trans : f =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => ↑n ^ (x - 1) :=
    by apply BigO.trans h_bigO h_periodic
  apply LSeriesSummable_of_isBigO_rpow s hs hx h_trans
